brief: Concrete stave silo about 16 ft across and 45 ft high, the staves weathered to a mottled grey-beige with dark water streaks and lichen, bound by rusty close-set hoops, capped by a low conical roof of rusty dark metal. It stands tight against the gable end of a long weathered-grey plank barn with a small cupola and an arched drive-through opening; pasture and fence posts in front, autumn woods behind.
